package handler

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	db "GENRE_MODULE/db"
	rules "GENRE_MODULE/game/rules"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
)

type IScenarioPlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
}

type IGameRoomEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.GameRoomDao
}

// 名单来自宿主的鉴权与成局结果，不接受客户端自由指定 actor 或成员。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerScenarioOpen(room IGameRoomEntity, members []int64, nowUnixMilli int64) error {
	if room.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		return errors.New("room already initialized")
	}
	state, err := rules.New(members, nowUnixMilli)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err == nil {
		room.Dao().SetState(string(raw))
	}
	return err
}

// actor 由接入层从已鉴权的玩家身份解析。期望版本阻止旧页面覆盖新状态；
// 同序号同内容返回原结果，改内容的重试拒绝。每位玩家只保留最后一条回执，旧序号不能重放。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerScenarioCommand(room IGameRoomEntity, player IScenarioPlayerEntity, cmd rules.Command, nowUnixMilli int64) (rules.Result, error) {
	var state rules.State
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(room.Dao().GetState()), &state); err != nil {
		return rules.Result{}, err
	}
	previous := state.Last[player.ID()]
	result, err := state.Apply(player.ID(), cmd, nowUnixMilli)
	if err != nil {
		return rules.Result{}, err
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err == nil {
		room.Dao().SetState(string(raw))
		if cmd.Seq > previous.Command.Seq {
			player.Dao().SetCoins(player.Dao().GetCoins() + int64(result.Reward))
		}
	}
	return result, err
}
